acceptedAnswer.text: As search engines increasingly integrate AI Overviews, these summaries are becoming a primary way users find information and businesses. For remodelers, optimizing for AI Overviews means ensuring your services are directly presented to users looking for home improvements. It provides a competitive edge by increasing your visibility in a new and growing search landscape, driving more relevant traffic to your site and potentially more project inquiries.
